presentation.label: FILTER HZ
presentation.summary: The FILTER page's FRQ popup shows the cutoff in hertz, from 13.8Hz to 21.1kHz, instead of 0 to 127.
presentation.overview: Filter Hz changes what the FRQ value popup on the FILTER page says. Instead of the stock 0 to 127 it shows the cutoff frequency to three significant figures: 13.8Hz at 0, 440Hz at 60, 1.11kHz at 76 and 21.1kHz at 127, one semitone a step. The scale comes from MrScruff's measurement of the self-oscillating filter. Only the text changes: the filter, its range, saved kits and every other parameter are untouched. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0008-filter-hz, with his code unchanged.
highlights: The FRQ popup reads in Hz and kHz to three significant figures.
One semitone a step, with 440Hz at the stock value 60.
Display only: the filter, its range and saved kits are unchanged.
MrScruff's rytm-mods code, unchanged, linked by the elemod core.
usage: Use a build containing Filter Hz. Select a track and press FILTER to open its FILTER page.
Turn FRQ (knob E). The value popup reads the cutoff in hertz instead of 0 to 127: 440Hz at the stock value 60, one semitone a step.
Turn FRQ fully right for 21.1kHz, the open filter, or fully left for 13.8Hz. RES and every other parameter still show their plain numbers.

access.location: Any track's FILTER page: the FRQ value popup (knob E).
steps: Select a track and press FILTER.
Turn FRQ (knob E); its value popup reads the cutoff in Hz or kHz.

controls.name: Knob E — FRQ
controls.doc: Unchanged control. Its value popup shows the cutoff frequency, 13.8Hz at 0 to 21.1kHz at 127, one semitone a step, instead of the number.

limitations: Built for OS 1.73 only, with core-ar2 0.1.
The scale was measured on the self-oscillating LP2 filter; the other filter types are assumed to share it.
The popup shows the knob's value: envelope depth, LFO modulation and parameter locks applied elsewhere are not included.
The 0 to 127 number is no longer shown for FRQ.

load.display: None in the audio path: runs only when the FRQ popup's text is drawn
load.conditions: Static: the one site is in param_value_text, the routine that formats a parameter's value text for the screen; nothing is added to the audio, sequencer or tick paths. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: Iced-Cream reports that on an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.73, in a build of core-ar2 0.1 and filter-hz 1.0, the FILTER page's FRQ popup shows the cutoff frequency in Hz (2026-10-13). The same port was then confirmed with all eleven rytm2_mods ports in one build.
limitations: Tested build: FZ01, .syx 58dec6c48bcd532e71fcb2ea46229ce9c41cb5337aa89e44efe7e3b294369830; firmware was not read back from the device.
Individual readings beyond the popup showing Hz were not itemized.

tests.summary: Hardware: the FRQ popup shows Hz on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.73 (Iced-Cream, 2026-10-13). Modwerk's source build linked with core-ar2 0.1 gives a main OS byte-identical to elekloader's build of the rytm2_mods v1.0 release. rytm-emu shows Hz where stock shows 60 and 127, and every other pixel the same.
